root_cause.text: Frag-transfer paths in the skbuff networking subsystem copied or moved skb frag descriptors without propagating the skb_shinfo()->flags SKBFL_SHARED_FRAG marker to the destination skb, causing shared/page-cache-backed frags to be misreported as unshared.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly says "__pskb_copy_fclone() and skb_shift() fail to propagate the SKBFL_SHARED_FRAG bit ... when moving frags from source to destination" and that "the destination skb keeps a reference to the same externally-owned or page-cache-backed pages while reporting skb_has_shared_frag() as false"; the patch fixes this by adding `skb_shinfo(dst)->flags |= skb_shinfo(src)->flags & SKBFL_SHARED_FRAG` in __pskb_copy_fclone(), skb_shift(), skb_gro_receive(), skb_gro_receive_list(), tcp_clone_payload(), and skb_segment().
